name: Composite Friction Saya (Sheath) — Silence
description:
The sheath (saya) for Silence — a custom-fitted composite friction saya in matte black. The saya is machined to the exact geometry of the blade, forming a friction-fit that holds the blade securely without a locking mechanism. The draw is silent: no click, no snap, no mechanical retention. The blade comes free with consistent, calibrated pull resistance, the same every time, regardless of orientation or ambient conditions.

The composite material is a carbon-fiber reinforced polymer with a superhydrophobic surface coating — water beads and sheds immediately, preventing moisture from entering the saya mouth and reaching the blade. The interior is lined with a fluoropolymer film that does not react with the blade's TENG film or ferrocerium substrate. Contact between the saya interior and the mune surface does not generate triboelectric charge — the saya material was selected specifically to avoid this. Drawing the blade from the saya does not pre-charge it; only the draw strop on Kyle's forearm does.

The saya rides across the back in a matte-black back carry mount, blade horizontal, grip at right shoulder. The mount is friction-locked to Kyle's tactical underlayer and releases with a thumb-press. He can draw from the back mount one-handed in approximately 0.3 seconds. This is not impressive by augmented-combatant standards. It is how Seo taught him.
specifications: Material: carbon-fiber reinforced polymer shell Interior lining: fluoropolymer film (PTFE-adjacent; triboelectrically matched to blade mune to prevent draw-charging) Surface coating: superhydrophobic, contact angle >150° Fit: custom friction-fit to Silence blade geometry Draw retention: calibrated friction, no mechanical lock Draw sound: silent Mount: back carry, horizontal, right-shoulder-draw Mount release: thumb-press friction lock Draw time (practiced): approximately 0.3 seconds from back mount

cost.part_only: Φ 680 (custom fabrication to blade geometry; standard composite materials)
cost.installation_labor: N/A — the saya does not require installation beyond being fitted to the blade during fabrication.
cost.total_installed: Φ 680 + Φ 200–400 for the back carry mount
cost.availability: Any composite fabrication shop can produce this to spec. The difficulty is providing the exact blade geometry for the friction fit. This requires either bringing the blade in person or providing precise dimensional data.
cost.notes: Interior lining material matters — the wrong polymer will triboelectrically charge the blade on every draw. The fluoropolymer lining specification is critical.
